title: Two-layer auth/transport separation (TransportConfig + AuthProvider)
description: auth.rs: TLS configuration (TransportConfig, consumed once at JmapClient::new) is correctly separated from per-request credential injection (AuthProvider, called per request). A contributor might propose merging them. The separation is justified: TLS config is consumed to build reqwest::Client and cannot change per-request; credentials can change. Box<dyn TransportConfig> vs Arc<dyn AuthProvider> blanket impls reflect ownership semantics correctly. Defend this structure.
